hypothesis: v3/v4 failed because zero-shot CLIP prompt scoring of SAM segments does not classify overhead views ('shadow' and then 'soil' absorbed most cells). A segmentation model trained on sub-metre land-cover labels (OpenEarthMap) labels each pixel directly and may classify the authors' model's views.
independence: Fixed before the model is run on any JAX_068 view. Not blind: chosen after v3/v4 failed on JAX_068. The model never saw Jacksonville, DFC2019 or US3D (OpenEarthMap regions, open-earth-map.org/attribution.html; xBD images not used). Only the source of per-pixel class probabilities changes from v4; views, projection, visibility, fusion, height rules, mapping and targets are v4's.
grid: DFC2019 JAX_068 truth grid (UTM 17N, 0.5 m, 512 x 512), as in v1-v4
surface: as v3/v4 (pipeline.semantics.top_surface) from the authors' model's rendered depth (artifacts/skyfall/JAX_068/final-depth/depth-points.npz)
placement: as v4: the measured horizontal offset from lidar (artifacts/skyfall/JAX_068/lidar-authors/dsm-validation.json: east -1 m, north +2 m) is removed before gridding, projection and splat assignment

model.training: configs/landcover-v5-kaggle.json on Kaggle (T4), notebook npsbrar1986/terrasplat-landcover-v5 version 2: 40,000 steps from nvidia/mit-b2 (revision 3bb39e8739149c3777d0325349b2a6c32c6413db), 2,303 OpenEarthMap train images; best step 36,000 chosen by validation mIoU
model.licence: OpenEarthMap labels mostly CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: the model and its classes are for non-commercial use

prediction.views: the 17 training views of the authors' JAX_068 dataset, cropped to the truth grid plus 48 px at native resolution (the same images as v4: LangSplat data/skyfall_jax068_authors_grid/images); the 2 test views are not used
prediction.output: float16 (H, W, 8) softmax probabilities per view, at image resolution

scoring.pixel: the model's 8 class probabilities at the view pixel
scoring.cell: each cell's top-surface point (gap-filled height) projected through each training camera (bundle-adjusted pinhole, deskewed image); nearest pixel; median over visible views, then argmax
scoring.visibility: as v4: inside the image, inside the deskew coverage mask, and not occluded: camera depth <= minimum depth of all top-surface points in the 3 x 3 pixel neighbourhood + 1.0 m (no segment-coverage condition: every pixel has probabilities)

rules: building -> building if hag >= 2.5 m, else ground
road -> road if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
developed space, bareland, agriculture land -> ground if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
water -> water if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
no top surface or fewer than 2 visible views -> unknown
classes.rules_note: v4's rules with OpenEarthMap names: rangeland takes v4's grass; developed space (paved, non-road) takes v4's parking; bareland and agriculture land take v4's soil.
classes.model_only_diagnostic: same argmax without height: building, vegetation, grass (rangeland), road, ground (developed space, bareland, agriculture land), water

splats: as v1-v4 (pipeline.semantics.splat_classes); the wall rule uses cells classified building

evaluation.scored_cells: truth not 65 and not 17; geometry as built (no registration shift)
evaluation.strict: our unknown cells count as incorrect
evaluation.headline: the height rules above; the model-only variant is reported as a diagnostic and cannot pass

rule: Model weights, prediction settings, fusion, rules and targets are fixed before any v5 prediction on JAX_068 and are not changed afterwards.
